verdict.rationale: Running untrusted code in sandboxes is a fair question for a cloud compute platform like Render, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows short-lived instances of your own service for one-off commands (render-docs-32) and ephemeral preview environments (render-docs-8). Nothing describes hardware isolation such as microVMs, sandboxing of untrusted or agent-generated code, or a disposable sandbox API, so no evidence shows it delivers this story.
